# The subject of the reference

This page is for a reader who looks for an exact rule. Say in 1 sentence what the page
defines.

Copy this file to `guides/reference/`, give it a name and add its line to
`docs/pages.exs`. Then replace each paragraph with the rules.

## The first group of items

Give each item of a kind the same headings of level 3, in the same sequence. Use tables.
Write no steps, no opinion and no history.

### The first item

| Part | Rule |
|---|---|
| Operands | Give each operand and its type |
| On a true rung | Say what the item does |
| On a false rung | Say what the item does |
| Power out | Say what the item gives to the next instruction |
| Faults | Give each fault and its cause |
| Diagnostics | Quote each message in a code span |

Show 1 small example with its mark, and its drawing if it is a rung.
